remarks: Spacious and freshly updated first-floor apartment in a convenient Stamford location! This versatile unit has been freshly painted throughout and features two completely renovated bathrooms, offering a clean, modern feel. The main level includes a large eat-in kitchen, comfortable living room, two bedrooms plus a den, and a full bath. New flooring in the living room is currently being installed, further enhancing the space.The finished lower level adds excellent flexibility with a third bedroom, full bathroom, brand new laundry room, living area, and kitchenette-ideal for extended living space, guests, or a private work-from-home setup. Additional highlights include two off-street parking spaces and a layout that offers plenty of room to spread out. Located just minutes from Downtown Stamford, residents can enjoy easy access to restaurants, shopping, and nightlife, along with nearby attractions like Mill River Park, Scalzi Park, and the vibrant dining scene along Bedford Street. Commuters will appreciate the quick access to Metro-North Railroad service at the nearby Stamford Transportation Center, plus convenient access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. A rare opportunity to rent a move-in ready, multi-level apartment with modern updates and plenty of space in one of Stamford's most convenient locations.
